groups.name: Egypt
groups.tagline: 12 Nights, 13 Days · Cairo, Luxor, Alexandria, Hurghada, Nile

offer.summary: 13 days trip built around Cairo, Luxor, Hurghada, Alexandria, Nile Cruise at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Africa journeys we shape by hand through Africa, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Experience The Great Pyramid of Giza with Sphinx, Museum, Khan El Khalili, Islamic Cairo.
In Luxor visit Valley of the Kings, Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple, Hatshepsut's Temple, Colossi of Memnon
In Hurghada Red Sea coral reefs for world-class diving, pristine beaches, and desert safari adventures.
Alexandria will give you Bibliotheca Alexandrina's modern library, Qaitbay Citadel's Mediterranean fortress, and ancient Roman catacombs
Sailing between Luxor & Aswan with stops at Edfu and Kom Ombo temples along the historic river

Scenic Great Rift Valley freshwater lake known for boat rides, hippos and abundant birdlife.
Extended game drives offering excellent chances to see lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants and the Great Migration route.
Kenya's vibrant safari capital, featuring Nairobi National Park, the Giraffe Centre and major wildlife-conservation experiences.

groups.name: Mauritius

highlights: Experience Mauritian culture at the Central Market and Chinatown, then explore the Caudan Waterfront and historic Fort Adelaide
Relax on white-sand beaches surrounded by turquoise lagoons, with options for snorkelling, parasailing and watersports

groups.name: Seychelles
groups.tagline: 6 Nights, 7 Days · Mahe Island, Praslin Island, La Digue Island, Vallee de Mai, Anse Lazio, Beau Vallon

offer.summary: 7 days trip built around Mahe Island, Praslin Island, La Digue Island, Vallee de Mai, Anse Lazio, and Beau Vallon at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Africa journeys we shape by hand through Seychelles, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Experience the vibrant culture, lush mountain trails, and stunning beaches of Mahe, including the famous Beau Vallon.
Discover the unique beauty of Praslin, home to the UNESCO-listed Vallee de Mai nature reserve and the pristine, world-renowned Anse Lazio beach.
Embrace the laid-back island life on La Digue, famous for its iconic granite rock formations and beaches best explored by bicycle.

groups.name: South Africa
groups.tagline: 9 Nights, 10 Days · Johannesburg, Cape Town, Pilanesberg, Knysna, Garden Route, Oudtshoorn, Suncity

offer.summary: 10 days trip built around Johannesburg, Cape Town, Pilanesberg, Knysna, Garden Route, Oudtshoorn at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Africa journeys we shape by hand through Africa, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Experience the historic Gold Reef City, featuring a surface tour, gold pouring demonstrations, and thrilling rides.

Explore iconic Table Mountain via the aerial cableway, enjoy a scenic Peninsula tour encompassing Cape Point, Boulders Beach, and Chapman's Peak, and indulge in an interactive 14-course dinner at Gold Restaurant.
Go on an exhilarating game drive in the Pilanesberg National Park to witness diverse wildlife in their natural habitat.
Cruise to the majestic Knysna Heads on the John Benn, enjoying stunning coastal views.
Traverse this scenic stretch, enjoying breathtaking landscapes and regional charm as you explore this beautiful coastal path.
Discover the fascinating Cango Caves, visit the Cango Wildlife Ranch, and enjoy an interactive experience at a Safari Ostrich Farm.
